package.name: kb_skills
package.description: KnowledgeCore client helpers and formal skill metadata for KB interactions.

export.skill: id: kb_query version: 1.0.0 description: | Query symbolic scene state from KnowledgeCore through the canonical `/kb/query` service. This is the phase-1 read-only KB surface used for chatbot grounding and future planner-facing scene lookups. interface: service default_interface_path: /kb/query datatype: kb_msgs/srv/Query functional_domains: - knowledge - perception parameters: in: - name: patterns type: string[] required: true description: Triple-pattern list sent to KnowledgeCore. - name: vars type: string[] required: true description: Variables projected in the query response. - name: models type: string[] default: [] description: Optional model scope used by the query. out: - name: json type: string description: JSON array of KnowledgeCore bindings. - name: success type: boolean description: True if KnowledgeCore accepted and answered the query. - name: error_msg type: string description: Error string returned by KnowledgeCore on failure.
